message: ncclUnhandledCudaError at init (cudaMalloc): Megatron custom FSDP keeps ~22.5 GiB allocator slack; 14B does not fit 8x H20
fix: custom FSDP only up to ~8B on 96 GB

message: Qwen3-30B-A3B on one 8x H20 node with fp32 optimizer state: OOM at any EP/TP (unsharded expert optimizer state 43.5 GB)
fix: bf16 main grads + moments (precision-aware optimizer) + --moe-layer-recompute, or 2 nodes with PP2

message: <= 0.6B models at mbs 8: fp32 logits (vocab 151936) need 18.6 GiB -> OOM

text: dense model, seq 4k, bf16, 8xH20: do not spend search budget on parallelism/overlap; tune fp8, attention backend and memory fit. Measured: mfu_attn_incl 0.78-0.83 (87% of measured GEMM peak); every parallel/overlap knob < 5%; 23-min sustained = 12-iteration window.

cuBLAS >= 12.8 injectable or torch >= 2.10 + torchao; every per-GPU GEMM dim >= 1024: enable FP8 (TE hybrid delayed / torchao Float8Linear + compile); at >= 14B pair it with bf16 main grads + NVLS off to fit. Measured: x1.43 (h 2048), 1.50 (2560), 1.54-1.59 (4096), 1.60-1.69 (5120); torchao 1.46 (8B) / 1.69 (32B with AC); memory +1.3-1.5 GiB per B local params unless fp8_param_gather.
FP8 with per-GPU GEMM dims <= 768 (e.g. 8B TP8): do not combine FP8 with high TP. Measured: x1.22 vs bf16 TP8 = speed of bf16 TP2.

dense model choosing TP / mbs / CP on one node: eff = 0.835 - 295/(w*sqrt(M_local/4096)), w = ffn/TP, M_local = mbs*seq/CP; choose the smallest TP that fits. Measured: 8B TP1/2/4/8 = 0.811/0.782/0.728/0.640; 14B 0.805/0.773/0.695; 32B TP8 0.735; TP8@32k 0.755; max error 0.011 on TP points, median 0.9% on 102 runs.

memory model says the config fits: recompute none; FSDP2 use selective_ops before full AC; never Megatron selective. Measured: full x0.776 (8B) / 0.759 (32B) / 0.786 (FP8) / 0.785 (FSDP2 AC); selective_ops x0.96 for -16.6 GiB; selective x0.975 for 0.3 GiB; AC+mbs2 +9.6%.

qwen3-32b dense on 8xH20: tp8 sp dp1 no recompute; FP8 version with bf16 main grads + NVLS off; never tp4 pp2 / tp2 pp4. Measured: 531 vs 406 (+31%); FP8 881 @74.8 GiB; PP4 -9% vs PP2; VPP4 +4.7%; 32k only TP8+recompute 306 @94.
any model, any codebase: attention_backend = auto (TE fused/cuDNN) or SDPA cudnn; do not search; verify no fallback. Measured: +4..+7% vs FA2 at 4k, +20.5% at 32k; efficient fails.

seq >= 32k dense: CP 2-4 with TP2-4 (p2p); 128k add full recompute; CP8 does not fit; cost model includes the attention term. Measured: TP2CP4 1.031x TP8; a2a 1.008x; 128k 571 vs 556; CP8 OOM at 32k/128k; 6N-MFU under-reports 29-44 points.
HF/FSDP2 at seq >= 32k without CP: loss_impl liger (or chunked) + full AC. Measured: HF CE OOM (18.55 GiB logits) vs 1294 @42.7 GiB.

qwen3-30b-a3b full fine-tune on 8xH20: ep8 tp1 etp1 + allgather dispatcher + moe-layer recompute + bf16 grads/moments + NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0 + expandable_segments; grouped GEMM on; permute fusion OFF (TE 2.3); mbs 1. Measured: 2070 (allgather +16.3%); grouped off -6.6%; permute fusion off +6.6%; ep4 tp2 etp2 -34%; tp2 pp2 ep2 +2.3%; fp32 state / no recompute / mbs2 / FP8 / NVLS on / 32k CP4 all OOM.

choosing a codebase at identical workload: framework multipliers vs mcore same TP: FSDP2 eager 0.887, FSDP2+compile 0.974, torchtitan FSDP 0.94 / compile 0.974, DTensor TP2 x0.86, DS Z1/Z2/Z3 0.927/0.915/0.883; <= 4B x0.95; mcore custom FSDP 0.98 (<= 8B only). Measured: F01/M22 0.920; F06/M22 1.010; T01/M22 0.976; T05/F06 1.001; T02/T01 0.864; D03/F01 0.996; M63/M02 0.981; F10/N01 0.864; F08/M11 0.817; F33/F01 1.003.

config does not fit: fit-knob priority: bf16 state > higher TP (eff0) > FSDP2 selective_ops > full recompute > mcore hybrid CPU optimizer > DS/FSDP2 CPU offload (set OMP threads). Measured: M62 +2.7%/-18 GiB; M67 0.56x; DS Z3 offload 0.48x (OMP28) / 0.28x (OMP1); FSDP2 0.37x / 0.26x; 70B single node 74.5 tok/s/GPU.

predicting peak memory: smi_pred = states + act - 0.8*N_local_B (+1.4*N_local_B TE FP8 w/o param-gather) + slack(stack) + non_torch(stack); fits <= 91, borderline 91-97, OOM > 97 GiB. Measured: non-torch mcore 9.3 / NVLS off 5.1 / TP>=4,CP 10.5-12.5 / FP8 11.8-13.5 / FP8+NVLS off 5.2-6.2 / userbuffers 12.9-14.1 / MoE NVLS on 16-17; torch-2.10 stacks 1.3; slack mcore 3, custom FSDP 22.5, MoE 12-15, FSDP2 10, ZeRO-3 20.

FSDP2/HF with reserved >= ~93.7 GiB: keep >= 7 GiB headroom (selective_ops AC / Liger / compile); never expandable_segments as a fit knob. Measured: mbs2 -14% (same config at 48 GiB with AC = equal speed); 14B no-AC cv 6%; expandable -47%.
mcore at 92-94 GiB smi: no near-OOM penalty; 2.5 GiB headroom suffices (flag late_oom_risk). Measured: cv <= 0.2% dense, <= 1.2% MoE.
sustained training: derating constant 1.0; no clock/power throttling; no drift over 23 min. Measured: S01 median 3.4625 s (= M22), drift -0.3%, cv 0.63%, SM 1980, 353/372 W, 63 C.
InfraRSI FR baseline on H20 (8B): expected search gain: +35% bf16 (remove recompute), +44% with bf16 grads, +128% with FP8. Measured: M30 1745 -> M22 2360 -> M62 2513 -> M75 3982.
NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: 0 by default. Measured: 0% throughput; -4.1 GiB dense, ~-6 GiB under FP8, -7.7 GiB MoE.
HF / torchtitan: torch.compile always on. Measured: +9.8% (F06), +10% with AC (F25), +3.7% torchtitan (T05); 7-11 s.
MoE expert GEMM shape: grouped GEMM on; gain +7% at 2048 rows/expert and larger below ~1k rows. Measured: M53 -6.6% when off; Phase-0 128 rows: 123/105 vs 72/43 TF.

CPU offload of any kind: cost is an additive CPU-Adam term c*N_params_per_rank_B: mcore hybrid 3.0-4.4 s/B, DeepSpeed 4.0 (OMP 28), FSDP2 6.5 (OMP 28), 10-13 (OMP 1); PCIe is not the bottleneck. Measured: predicts M67/M72/M69 within 4%, D07o/F23o/F24o within 10%.
TE userbuffers tp_comm_overlap: keep off. Measured: -7.9% TP2, -3.8% TP8, +3 GiB non-torch.
small dense models (<= 4B): largest mbs that fits; expect <= 5%; logits cap mbs (0.6B mbs8 OOM). Measured: 1.7B mbs1->4 +5.0%; 4B mbs1->2 +0.6%; FP8 +43/+50%.

FP8 training with TE, long context: enable FP8 dot-product attention only with cuDNN >= 9.10 (TE 2.3 + cuDNN 9.1 has no backend); mcore 0.13 has no CLI switch (set TransformerConfig.fp8_dot_product_attention). Measured: +6.3 % at 4k, +27.6 % at 32k on top of FP8 GEMMs; 32k FP8 + FP8 attention 1.69x bf16.

FP8 on bigger models on one 8x H20 node: the FP8 gain grows with model size. Measured: 70B with the hybrid CPU optimizer +41 % (W09 vs M72, 105 vs 74.5 tok/s/GPU); 32B FP8 + FP8 attention 928 tok/s/GPU (W25) vs FP8 881 (M71) and bf16 531 (M11).

other low-precision options on this stack (torch 2.6/2.10, torchao 0.15, TE 2.3): prune INT8 training and FP8 rowwise; treat fp16 and 8-bit AdamW as memory knobs only. Measured: torchao INT8 +0.5 %; FP8 rowwise -38 % vs tensorwise (torchao and torchtitan); fp16 +3.4 % and -16 GB; AdamW8bit +0 % and -9 GB.

common SFT stacks for 8B on one node: treat HF Trainer (FSDP1/FSDP2/DS ZeRO-2/3) as equivalent to a hand-written FSDP2/DS loop; the knobs that matter are compile, attention backend, precision. Measured: HF Trainer 2162-2240 vs custom 2162-2240 tok/s/GPU.

LoRA SFT on H20: LoRA r16 is 1.24-1.34x full fine-tune tok/s; 70B LoRA fits one node with FSDP2 + full AC. Measured: 8B 2917 (1.34x); 32B + AC 539; 70B + AC 275 tok/s/GPU at 63 GB; HF Trainer FSDP1 LoRA 2534.

where step time goes (device-kernel share, one optimizer step, rank 0; GPU-timeline annotations nccl:/FSDP::/Optimizer./CompiledFxGraph excluded): dense mcore is GEMM-bound; FSDP2/DS hide most NCCL; single-node MoE is communication-bound -> optimize the dispatcher/EP layout before kernels. Measured: mcore 8B bf16 GEMM 76 % / attn 9 % / NCCL 6 %; FP8 GEMM 70 % / attn 14 %; FSDP2 GEMM 67 % / NCCL 10 %; DS ZeRO-3 GEMM 63 % / NCCL 17 % (overlapped); MoE EP8 NCCL 36 %, GEMM 36 %; blockwise FP8 GEMM 44 % / NCCL 14 %.

hybrid linear-attention architectures (Gated DeltaNet 3:1 + gated attention): trainable with HF transformers 5.13 + fla 0.5.1 + FSDP2 on torch 2.6; use flash SDPA (cuDNN SDPA has no kernel for head_dim 256 GQA on torch 2.6); long context is cheap (linear layers are O(T)). Measured: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 12/40 layers 4859 tok/s/GPU at 4k, 5493 at 16k + full AC; Qwen3.8-27B 16/64 layers 2356 at 4k.

torchtitan 0.2.2 features on H20: use CP for long context without TP (TP + CP broken), FSDP float8 all-gather with float8; skip async TP. Measured: PP2 1F1B 0.89x / ZBV 0.99x of FSDP8; CP8 32k 1385 (allgather = alltoall); async TP +0 %; float8 AG +8 %; 32B float8 1.67x bf16; MoE EP8 0.74x Megatron.
QLoRA (bitsandbytes NF4) vs bf16 LoRA on H20, 32B real weights: QLoRA costs about 7 % throughput for 4x smaller frozen weights. Measured: 495 vs 534 (DDP) / 539 (FSDP2).

full-depth hybrid GDN architectures on one 8 x H20 node (FSDP2, fp32 Adam): Qwen3.8-27B fits with full AC; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B needs less optimizer memory (8-bit, offload or 2 nodes). Measured: 27B 557 tok/s/GPU; 35B-A3B OOM.
best 8B single-node H20 config: TP1 DP8 + FP8 delayed + bf16 main grads + FP8 attention. Measured: 4225 tok/s/GPU (+6 % over 3982).

more low-precision options on H20 (torchao 0.15, torchtitan 0.2.2, torch 2.10 cu128): blockwise FP8 (torchao Triton) is worth it in eager mode only; prefer tensorwise + compile; skip the MoE float8 grouped-GEMM prototype. Measured: blockwise FP8 eager 3106 = 1.43x bf16 eager, 0.89x tensorwise+compile; rowwise_with_gw_hp 2914 (tensorwise 3439, rowwise 2118); MoE float8 grouped GEMM 0.60x bf16.
Search-space pruning on 8x H20: attention_backend / sdpa -> auto (TE fused=cuDNN) / cudnn (flash -4..-7% at 4k, -17% at 32k; efficient fails).
Search-space pruning on 8x H20: overlap_grad_reduce, overlap_param_gather -> true (off -0.2%).
Search-space pruning on 8x H20: tp_comm_overlap (TE userbuffers) -> false (-8% TP2, -4% TP8, +3 GiB non-torch).
Search-space pruning on 8x H20: sequence_parallel -> true when TP>1 (off +0.6% but +3.4 GiB).
Search-space pruning on 8x H20: CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS -> 1 (mcore TP) / 8 (mcore FSDP paths) (8 vs 1 at TP1 = -1%).
